source: Issue55 task: fixed M1-M8, customizable M9/M10

layer_ownership.boundary_rule: Every customizable 8-9 via bottom landing must be fully covered by the pre-existing fixed M8 landing. It must add zero M1-M8 conductor area.
layer_ownership.same_base_rule: All target-specific variants retain identical instances, masters, placement/orientation, fixed lower-metal conductor coverage, fixed via definitions/positions and fixed pin-access resource IDs.

proposed_steps: First migrate original signal wires off reserved layers and qualify unchanged cells, non-target wires and PG.
Enumerate real BPin rectangles and real track patterns. Treat ports as distinct electrical terminals, not declared bandwidth.
Generate candidate escape corridors outside the original macro boundary or in explicitly available internal regions, honoring lower-layer obstructions and PG.
Assign each port a stable M8 landing ID and one fixed escape path including required lower vias.
Validate every escape against all original and other escape conductors, PG and pins; run native DRC and full-model RC/STA.
Enclose all fixed escape geometry in the wrapper footprint, include keepouts, and qualify nonoverlapping footprints.
Freeze one common access map and lower-metal database before target-specific V8/M9/V9/M10 routing.
Compare physical metal coverage at the boundary, so a duplicate via landing record cannot hide added metal or falsely imply a mask change.

candidate_access_patterns.condition: Only after native obstruction/PG/route clearance and full physical checks establish available regions

observed_case_constraints.capacity_formula: 4 * (floor(side / 1.6) + 1), before corners, PG, obstacles, direction, actual track phase or larger width-dependent spacing
observed_case_constraints.capacity_limitation: Necessary-count screening only; does not prove any access path exists.

required: no unapproved changes to original lower geometry
V8 bottom-metal area contained in fixed pads
original and new RC/STA with complete cell/memory libraries and annotation coverage
